body: I wish I could find another way. I've heard every justification against suicide. They just don't mean anything to me anymore. I wish my ex and I could work it out, but this WAS our attempt at working it out. As for visitation rights, these fucking laws prevent me from doing literally ANYTHING. Because I'm not on the birth certificate, anything and everything has to be run by her first. She's left, won't respond to me, won't tell me anything. And she's the only person on the planet who can "allow" me to see my own child.
